reason: I already threw away most of the PRs background agents opened for us, and a pipeline drawing doesn't change that the agent writes the code. Pre-alpha from one developer, running unattended on client repos, is not something I can sell to my clients or my boss.
objection: Our clients may not allow AI agents on their code at all, let alone unattended overnight runs, and I don't trust overnight PRs to be worth reviewing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it produce mergeable PRs on one of our internal repos for two weeks with the free self-hosted version, plus a clear story for client data and compliance.
